title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. basalticum
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. basalticum, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium glaucinum subsp. basalticum may include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
